summary: Tested Resend email receipts, anonymous no-email, public donation reconstruction, admin send-reminders (backend + UI), and /doacao/pix?don= reconstruction. All 9 backend tests passed and all 4 frontend flows passed. Real Resend sends to delivered@resend.dev returned email_sent=true and the reminder sent=1, failed=0.

minor.issue: Sends one email at a time with no throttling or batching. Resend rate limits (about 2 req/s by default) will make sends fail once there are many donors. Every email goes in one request, so a large list may hit the request timeout. Errors are swallowed and not logged.
Reminders also go to donors who already paid or copied the code (no filter on copied/paid). Nothing stops repeated clicks from emailing all donors again.
Public endpoint, and donation_id is a millisecond timestamp that can be guessed. Anyone can enumerate IDs and read donor_name and value. Consider a random token (uuid) in the email link.

Resend runs inline before the response, which adds latency to PIX donation creation. Consider a BackgroundTask. Exceptions in email_service are swallowed without logging, so failures cannot be diagnosed.

issues: 'Enviar lembrete' sends emails right away with no confirmation dialog, which is risky for a bulk email action.
The header logo next to 'Painel Administrativo' shows as a small cropped red graphic and looks broken.

action_items: Add a confirmation dialog before sending reminders
Throttle or batch reminder sends (e.g. resend.Batch or sleep between sends) and log Resend exceptions
Consider filtering out donors who already paid or copied from reminders
Consider a non-guessable token for the public /donation/{id} reconstruction link
critical_code_review_comments: email_service.py: send_donation_receipt and send_donation_reminder repeat the env and config logic. Extract a shared _send helper.
admin_routes.py: donation_id comes from a timestamp and can collide when two donations land in the same millisecond. There is no unique index.
seed_data_creation: Test donations created with origin TEST and delivered@resend.dev were deleted by ID afterwards. The 2 pre-existing donations were left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_email_reminders.py -p no:xdist. Before calling send-reminders, check that the DB has no real donor emails (only delivered@resend.dev existed). Admin login is at /donaspainel and uses testids login-username-input, login-password-input and login-submit-button.
